Name: Visit Jojacorp
Author: childfarm
Description:
[size=5]Description:[/size]
[size=3]This mod allows you to visit your workplace that you saw in the intro. It also has three additional maps, mostly to make the thing seem more realistic, but one of the map contains a shop. It can only be accessed using the train, via the train stations mod.

[/size][size=5]Shop:
[/size][size=3]The shop,  located in a room next to the dead skeleton in the office cubicle, contains Jojamart merch as well as items that are in the game's code but unobtainable. It also contains a crafting recipe.

[/size][size=4]Joja merch -
[/size]Joja Cola - 50g (it's sold for 25 cents cheaper here)
J.cola Light - 500g (same price as Jojamart)
Joja Cola shirt - 400g (The shirt that you get when you put a Joja Cola on the sewing machine. I decided to make it slightly cheaper than the sell price of cloth.)
Soda machine - 50000g (Since you have to go the Joja route to get this and you get only one in vanilla, I decided it made sense to put it here for sale.)

[size=4]Unobtainables -
[/size]All of the below are in the game's code, including the sprite, name, and description, but have no known way of being obtained in vanilla. Because they also fit with the theme of the store, I put them in the stock. I priced them like normal furniture, even though they look pretty crusty ngl.

Ancient Table - 500g
Ancient stool - 300g 
Grandfather clock - 750g
Teddy Timer - 750g
Dead Tree - 500g

[size=4]Crafting Recipe
[/size]I made the store sell a new crafting recipe for mushroom boxes. This is the same box in the mushroom caves that produces mushrooms every day. Mushrooms are not easy to farm, so I added this. You can also pickaxe the mushroom boxes in your cave into your inventory and then move them somewhere else more convenient. Works indoors and outdoors. To balance things out, I made the recipe a bit on the difficult side.

Recipe:
1 rotten plant (jack o lanterns turn into these on the first of winter, and if you place the lewis statue outside and it doesn't get destroyed, the next day it's replaced with a rotten plant and you can get the statue from either Lewis or Marnie's room to do it again)
5 trash 
20 wood
20 Joja Cola (Because it's the perfect thing to attract fungus.)

[size=5]Instructions
[/size]
Make sure you have Smapi installed and the mods Content Patcher, Shop Tiles Framework, and Train Station.  Unzip Visit Jojacorp. Place it in your mods folder.

[size=5]Credits:
[/size][url=https://limezu.itch.io/]LimeZu - itch.io[/url]'s modern interiors pack for the elevator and sofa sprites used in the lobby.
